reason: E2 shows grain refinement and property improvement via cold-rolling and annealing in a Co-rich HEA, supporting the first two premises. E3 shows hot rolling improves ductility in Ti-based MEAs, partially supporting the third premise. However, no cited evidence addresses MnNiSi-based alloys or the preservation of magnetocaloric phases during rapid annealing, leaving key premises unsupported.
premises: Cold deformation followed by rapid annealing refines grains in alloys.
Grain refinement enhances strength and ductility.
Short annealing time minimizes diffusion and preserves phases.
Thermomechanical processing can be applied to MnNiSi-based alloys.
